Excellence in NDT Consulting & Training | Atlantis NDT

Atlantis NDT is a global leader in Non-Destructive Testing services. We deliver excellence in NDT consulting and training across the USA, India, and Middle East.

Our team includes over 50 ASNT Level III certified professionals. Each expert brings decades of hands-on experience to every project. We have completed over 1,000 inspections worldwide.

NDT Consulting Services

Our NDT consulting services cover all major testing methods. These include ultrasonic testing and radiographic testing. We also specialize in magnetic particle testing and penetrant testing. Eddy current testing and visual inspection complete our service offerings.

Our consultants help businesses meet industry codes and safety standards. We develop written procedures per ASNT SNT-TC-1A. Quality and reliability are our top priorities.

  • NDT Consulting Services - Expert Level III consulting for all industries
  • NDT Consulting USA - Houston-based services
  • NDT Consulting India - Hyderabad office
  • NDT Consulting Middle East - UAE and Gulf region

NDT Training Programs

NDT training is at the core of what we do. We offer certification programs per ASNT SNT-TC-1A guidelines. Our courses cover Level I, Level II, and Level III certifications.

Students receive hands-on practice with real equipment. We maintain a 95% pass rate across all our training programs. Expert instructors guide every session.

  • NDT Training Programs - Level I, II, III certification courses
  • NDT Training USA - Houston training center
  • NDT Training India - Hyderabad facility
  • NDT Training Hyderabad - Local courses

NDT Methods We Cover

We provide training and consulting for all major NDT methods. Each method serves specific inspection needs.

  • Ultrasonic Testing (UT) - Thickness measurement and flaw detection
  • Radiographic Testing (RT) - Internal structure imaging
  • Magnetic Particle Testing (MT) - Surface crack detection
  • Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT) - Surface discontinuities
  • Eddy Current Testing (ET) - Conductivity and coating measurement
  • Visual Testing (VT) - Direct visual inspection

Industries We Serve

We serve industries where quality and safety matter most. Our clients include oil and gas companies and aerospace manufacturers. We also work with marine operators and nuclear facilities.

  • Oil & Gas NDT - Refineries, pipelines, offshore
  • Aerospace NDT - Aircraft and components
  • Power Generation NDT - Turbines and boilers

Innovation drives our approach to NDT excellence. We use Digital Twin technology for advanced asset visualization. This helps clients identify defects early. Our VR and AR training modules provide immersive learning experiences.
